state:
**Goal `performance-pass`, Stage 3 (the ladders) is done as far as the goal prose names it, and Stage 4 (the review) is next.** All 22 areas have a ladder, and `bun nv scaling --areas` prints `every area has a ladder`. `bun nv scaling` in `tools/nv/cmd/scaling.ts` measures six kinds (`run`, `compile`, `lsp`, `fmt`, `serve`, `fetch`); its module doc is the home of the ramp, the bounds, `KINDS`, `AREAS`, the `serve` sizes and the `fetch` server.

**The `app` area has five ladders, all flat:** `requests.nvs` (`serve`, requests served), `clients.nvs` (`serve`, `size connections`, 16 to 512), `rows.nvs` (`run`, products per page, counts at slope 1.00), `modules.nvs` (`compile`, n page classes each with a route) and `editor.nvs` (`lsp`, the same program, clock 1.13). No queued job yet: the queue needs the `nvs_jobs` tables `queue/jobs.nvs` creates.

**Ladders that grow:** `fmt/classes.nvs`, `lsp/classes.nvs`, and `numbers/bigint-mul.nvs` (under *Benches to look at*). `docs/perf/performance-pass.md` *What we found* now has the two server findings checked: an unread POST body from 16 KB closes the connection after the response, and at 512 KB loses the response in 6 of 20 tries; 100 header lines get a correct `431`, which is not a defect. The 1.05 MB per `Core\Task` is still unexplained.

**Still red:** `--areas --reviewed` (`docs/perf/performance-review.md` does not exist, Stage 4) and `scaling --check` (the growing ladders, Stage 5). `lspInstructions` has not run, and `--iterations --check` has had no full sweep.

items.text: **Write `docs/perf/performance-review.md`** with one `## <area>` section per entry of `AREAS`, which `areas()` at `tools/nv/cmd/scaling.ts:846` reads. Fan out one read-only `Explore` subagent per area, two or three per message, each given the area's crates from the goal prose's Stage 3 table and the shapes Stage 4 lists; each finding becomes a gap record under `data/gaps/` owned by `performance-pass`. Rule: `rule:testing/bench-counters`.

**Find where `nvs serve` decides to close on an unread body**, starting from the connection loop in `crates/nvs-cli/src/serve.rs:1`: the response must be flushed before the close, at every size. A fix that drains a bounded amount of the body before closing spends no memory per request beyond that bound. Rule: `rule:testing/bench-counters`.
